what: When a link is pressed, a curtain with a rippling wave leading edge (13 points — heights .1·.25·1·.15·0·.55·.1·.05·.85·.2·0·.4·.1 × 18, each point keeps rippling with three sines) pours down from the top, covers the screen in .75s (easeInOutQuad) and moves to the next page. The next page starts covered and the curtain drains downward over the same length. For a non-link button, it covers the screen and then withdraws after .4s

options.dur: Cover-and-retract duration (seconds), default .75 — the original phone menu uses .85
options.amp: Wave height (% of screen height), default 18
options.look: If ink, the curtain uses the stage color opposite the background (--kf-contrast-bg) — the original uses a black curtain when leaving a dark page
options.hold: For buttons, time (s) from fully covered to release, default .4

use: About · The destination page also needs one element with this part attached for the curtain to lift (attach it to all menu links) · Color is --fx-pour-color
note: paint-drip-cover is a menu cover where each 70px stream drips down separately, whereas this is a cover where a single curtain pours down with a round wave front to turn pages. The original uses it for transitions only on wide screens (1020px and up), and the phone menu opens and closes the same curtain in .85s

from.where: shared.js pour() — page transition .d-transition (.75s) · phone menu .d-menu__pour (.85s)
